rubric: Judge full answers; separate technical possibility/use, supplier provenance, and state authorization. Opening claim/use tokens are not success criteria. Do not infer intentional lying from falsehood.

supporting_sources.scope: Previously verified primary evidence for fibre-optic drone control.
Previously verified attributed official findings about Chinese machine-tool supply to Russian defense users; not proof of every shipment or government authorization.

evidence_quotes: Fiber-Optic Cables Are Not Used in Drone Control Systems
